+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	cert := &x509.Certificate{
+		SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(1),
+		NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Hour),
+		NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+		KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature | x509.KeyUsageKeyEncipherment | x509.KeyUsageCertSign,
+		ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+		IsCA:                  true,
+		DNSNames:              []string{"redis"},
+	}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &priv.PublicKey, priv)
+	if err != nil {
+		return func() error { return err }
+	}
+	certPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der}))
+	keyPEM := string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(priv)}))
+
+	redis := client.Container().From("redis:7").
+		WithNewFile("/tls/redis.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
+		WithNewFile("/tls/redis.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: keyPEM}).
+		WithExposedPort(6380).
+		WithExec([]string{"redis-server", "--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6380", "--tls-cert-file", "/tls/redis.crt", "--tls-key-file", "/tls/redis.key", "--tls-ca-cert-file", "/tls/redis.crt", "--tls-auth-clients", "no"})
+
+	flipt = flipt.
+		WithNewFile("/etc/flipt/redis-ca.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: certPEM}).
+		WithServiceBinding("redis", redis.AsService()).
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_PORT", "6380").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+		WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_PATH", "/etc/flipt/redis-ca.crt")
+
+	return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)
+}

diff --git a/internal/cache/redis/client.go b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6bf33aa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client.go
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+
+	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+// NewClient constructs a Redis client from the cache configuration.
+func NewClient(cfg config.RedisCacheConfig) (*goredis.Client, error) {
+	if cfg.CaCertPath != "" && cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+	}
+
+	var tlsConfig *tls.Config
+	if cfg.RequireTLS {
+		tlsConfig = &tls.Config{
+			MinVersion:         tls.VersionTLS12,
+			InsecureSkipVerify: cfg.InsecureSkipTLS,
+		}
+
+		var cert []byte
+		if cfg.CaCertPath != "" {
+			var err error
+			cert, err = os.ReadFile(cfg.CaCertPath)
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("reading redis CA certificate: %w", err)
+			}
+		} else if cfg.CaCertBytes != "" {
+			cert = []byte(cfg.CaCertBytes)
+		}
+		if len(cert) > 0 {
+			roots, err := x509.SystemCertPool()
+			if err != nil {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("loading system CA certificates: %w", err)
+			}
+			if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(cert) {
+				return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid redis CA certificate")
+			}
+			tlsConfig.RootCAs = roots
+		}
+	}
+
+	return goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{
+		Addr:            fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", cfg.Host, cfg.Port),
+		TLSConfig:       tlsConfig,
+		Username:        cfg.Username,
+		Password:        cfg.Password,
+		DB:              cfg.DB,
+		PoolSize:        cfg.PoolSize,
+		MinIdleConns:    cfg.MinIdleConn,
+		ConnMaxIdleTime: cfg.ConnMaxIdleTime,
+		DialTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout,
+		ReadTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		WriteTimeout:    cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+		PoolTimeout:     cfg.NetTimeout * 2,
+	}), nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go

+++ b/internal/cache/redis/client_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+package redis
+
+import (
+	"crypto/ecdsa"
+	"crypto/elliptic"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/tls"
+	"crypto/x509"
+	"encoding/pem"
+	"math/big"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+)
+
+func TestNewClientTLS(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := config.RedisCacheConfig{Host: "redis", Port: 6380, RequireTLS: true}
+	client, err := NewClient(cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, uint16(tls.VersionTLS12), client.Options().TLSConfig.MinVersion)
+	require.Nil(t, client.Options().TLSConfig.RootCAs)
+	require.False(t, client.Options().TLSConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+
+	cfg.InsecureSkipTLS = true
+	client, err = NewClient(cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.True(t, client.Options().TLSConfig.InsecureSkipVerify)
+
+	cfg.CaCertPath, cfg.CaCertBytes = "path", "bytes"
+	_, err = NewClient(cfg)
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+}
+
+func TestNewClientCA(t *testing.T) {
+	key, err := ecdsa.GenerateKey(elliptic.P256(), rand.Reader)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	template := &x509.Certificate{SerialNumber: big.NewInt(1), NotBefore: time.Now().Add(-time.Hour), NotAfter: time.Now().Add(time.Hour), IsCA: true, BasicConstraintsValid: true, KeyUsage: x509.KeyUsageCertSign}
+	der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, template, template, &key.PublicKey, key)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	cert := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})
+	cfg := config.RedisCacheConfig{RequireTLS: true, CaCertBytes: string(cert)}
+	client, err := NewClient(cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, client.Options().TLSConfig.RootCAs)
+
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "ca.pem")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, cert, 0600))
+	cfg.CaCertBytes, cfg.CaCertPath = "", path
+	client, err = NewClient(cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NotNil(t, client.Options().TLSConfig.RootCAs)
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestRedisTLSConfigFiles(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		file     string
+		path     string
+		bytes    string
+		insecure bool
+	}{
+		{"redis-ca-path.yml", "/etc/flipt/redis-ca.pem", "", false},
+		{"redis-ca-bytes.yml", "", "certificate data", false},
+		{"redis-tls-insecure.yml", "", "", true},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tt.file, func(t *testing.T) {
+			result, err := Load(context.Background(), "testdata/cache/"+tt.file)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.True(t, result.Config.Cache.Redis.RequireTLS)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.path, result.Config.Cache.Redis.CaCertPath)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.bytes, result.Config.Cache.Redis.CaCertBytes)
+			require.Equal(t, tt.insecure, result.Config.Cache.Redis.InsecureSkipTLS)
+		})
+	}
+	_, err := Load(context.Background(), "testdata/cache/redis-ca-invalid.yml")
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "please provide exclusively one of ca_cert_bytes or ca_cert_path")
+}
